purpose: 完整读取原29问卷当前字段与方法，核原钟和版本，不读股票标签；映射全部原1711/1212成熟池
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib,re,csv
import numpy as np,pandas as pd,pdfplumber
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
now=lambda:datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(n,o):
 p=out/n
 if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('不覆盖原研究记录：'+n)
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
proto=readj(out/'protocol.json')
releases={x['quarter']:x for x in readj(out/'全部原发布钟与实际附件链接.json')['quarters']}
receipts={x['quarter']:x for x in readj(out/'全部原报告PDF首次本地取得回执.json')['receipts']}
rows=[];later=[];missing=[];allpages=[]
ch={'1':'一','2':'二','3':'三','4':'四'}
for qq in proto['target_quarters']:
 q=qq.replace('-','');r=receipts.get(q);release=releases.get(q)
 row={'quarter':q,'source_gate_qualified':False,'original_current_rate_percent':None,'original_publication_display':release['original_publication_display'] if release else 'UNKNOWN'}
 if not r or not r.get('success'):
  row['reason']='UNKNOWN_NO_ORIGINAL_PDF';rows.append(row);missing.append(q);continue
 p=root/r['path'];assert ident(p)['sha256']==r['sha256'],'原PDF身份变化：'+q
 with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
  metadata={k:str(v) for k,v in pdf.metadata.items()}
  pages=[{'pdf_page_1based':i+1,'text':pg.extract_text() or ''} for i,pg in enumerate(pdf.pages)]
 full='\n'.join(z['text'] for z in pages);norm=re.sub(r'\s+','',full).replace('％','%')
 title=q[:4]+'年第'+ch[q[-1]]+'季度银行家问卷调查报告'
 currenttitle=title in norm
 candidates=[]
 for pg in pages:
  clean=re.sub(r'\s+','',pg['text']).replace('％','%')
  for m in re.finditer(r'贷款总体需求指数为([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)%',clean):
   candidates.append({'value_percent':float(m.group(1)),'pdf_page_1based':pg['pdf_page_1based'],'original_context':clean[max(0,m.start()-90):m.end()+220]})
 method=[]
 for pg in pages:
  clean=re.sub(r'\s+','',pg['text'])
  for m in re.finditer('贷款总体需求指数[：:]',clean):
   method.append({'pdf_page_1based':pg['pdf_page_1based'],'original_context':clean[max(0,m.start()-20):m.end()+220]})
 methodexplicit=any(all(a in z['original_context'] for a in ['贷款总体需求','增长','基本不变','0.5']) for z in method)
 pub=row['original_publication_display']
 late=False;metadates=[]
 if pub!='UNKNOWN':
  pubday=pub[:10].replace('-','')
  for k in ['CreationDate','ModDate','SourceModified']:
   m=re.search(r'(?:D:)?(20\d{6})',metadata.get(k,''))
   if m:
    metadates.append({'metadata_field':k,'original_date_digits':m.group(1),'later_than_original_publication_calendar_day':m.group(1)>pubday})
    if m.group(1)>pubday:late=True
  if late:later.append(q)
 row.update(current_requested_title_in_original_text=currenttitle,full_pdf_pages=len(pages),pdf=ident(p),release=ident(root/release['release_receipt']['path']),
   current_named_value_candidates=candidates,original_method_contexts=method,original_method_current_object_explicit=methodexplicit,
   original_pdf_metadata=metadata,metadata_date_checks=metadates,known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release=late,
   current_numeric_to_clock_scope='原命名当前季正文/真实发布页及实际附件对应、元日期未见晚于发布日矛盾的历史重构；不认证历史首收/每一数值的不可变首版。',
   actual_questionnaire_collection_start='UNKNOWN',actual_questionnaire_collection_end='UNKNOWN',
   statistic_period='原问卷本季主观判断；不是季末已实现贷款数量，不人为填季度末为访谈截止',
   historical_first_vintage_authenticated=False,current_original_received_at=r['completed_at'])
 qualified=currenttitle and len(candidates)==1 and methodexplicit and pub!='UNKNOWN' and not late
 row['source_gate_qualified']=qualified
 if len(candidates)==1:row['original_current_rate_percent']=candidates[0]['value_percent']
 if not qualified:row['reason']='TARGET_TITLE_VALUE_METHOD_CLOCK_OR_LATER_VERSION_NOT_QUALIFIED'
 rows.append(row);allpages.append({'quarter':q,'pdf':ident(p),'all_pages_full_text':pages})
 print('原目标',q,'值',row['original_current_rate_percent'],'方法',methodexplicit,'晚版本',late,'资格',qualified,flush=True)
save('全部29原问卷全文与目标当前值方法.json',{'study_id':proto['study_id'],'completed_at':now(),'targets':rows,'all_original_pages_full_text':allpages,
 'all_current_numeric_fields_are_current_report_not_later_table_quotes':True,'later_version_quarters':later,'missing_current_original_quarters':missing})
fullsource=all(r['source_gate_qualified'] for r in rows) and len(rows)==29
baseproto=readj(root/'reports/research/510300_csi300_csi500_relative_price_increment_v1/protocol.json')
features8=baseproto['fixed_model_plan']['features8_reused']
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet'
cols=['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']+features8
d=pd.read_parquet(parent,columns=cols)
poolpath=root/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json'
pools=readj(poolpath)
originalmembers=sorted(set(int(z['idx']) for z in pools)|{int(i) for z in pools for i in z['training_indices']})
assert len(pools)==1212 and len(originalmembers)==1711
d['贷款总体需求指数']=np.nan;d['贷款需求经济季度']=None;d['贷款需求原公布可知时间']=None;d['贷款需求信息龄_自然日']=np.nan;d['贷款需求源完整']=False
pubrows=[]
for r in rows:
 if r['original_publication_display']!='UNKNOWN':
  pub=pd.Timestamp(r['original_publication_display'],tz='Asia/Shanghai')
  pubrows.append((pub,r['quarter'],r))
pubrows.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
for i,t in zip(d.idx.astype(int),pd.to_datetime(d.decision_time)):
 cutoff=pd.Timestamp(t)
 if cutoff.tzinfo is None:cutoff=cutoff.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')
 eligible=[(pub,q,r) for pub,q,r in pubrows if pub<=cutoff]
 if not eligible:continue
 published_quarters=[q for _,q,_ in eligible]
 newest=max(published_quarters)
 choices=[(pub,q,r) for pub,q,r in eligible if q==newest]
 pub,q,r=max(choices,key=lambda x:x[0])
 d.loc[i,'贷款需求经济季度']=q
 d.loc[i,'贷款需求原公布可知时间']=pub.isoformat()
 d.loc[i,'贷款需求信息龄_自然日']=(cutoff-pub).total_seconds()/86400
 if r['source_gate_qualified']:
  d.loc[i,'贷款总体需求指数']=r['original_current_rate_percent']
  d.loc[i,'贷款需求源完整']=True
d.to_parquet(out/'原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签.parquet',index=False)
member=d[d.idx.isin(originalmembers)][['idx','date','decision_time','贷款总体需求指数','贷款需求经济季度','贷款需求原公布可知时间','贷款需求信息龄_自然日','贷款需求源完整']]
member.to_csv(out/'全部1711原成员_需求信息与原公布钟.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
poolrows=[]
for z in pools:
 i=int(z['idx']);members=[int(x) for x in z['training_indices']]
 bad=d.loc[[i]+members,'贷款总体需求指数'].isna()
 poolrows.append({'idx':i,'date':z['date'],'original_mature_rows':len(members),'current_field_known':bool(pd.notna(d.loc[i,'贷款总体需求指数'])),'complete_original_current_and_pool_known':not bool(bad.any()),'unknown_members_in_current_and_pool':int(bad.sum()),'max_label_exit_idx':z['max_label_exit_idx'],'any_original_member_deleted':False})
pd.DataFrame(poolrows).to_csv(out/'全部1212原评分日_需求全成熟池支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
ready=sum(r['complete_original_current_and_pool_known'] for r in poolrows)
allready=fullsource and ready==1212 and member['贷款总体需求指数'].notna().all()
gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E77','completed_at':now(),
 'status':'QUALIFIED_COMPLETE_29_ORIGINAL_BANKERS_LOAN_DEMAND_HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION_SOURCE_AND_ALL_ORIGINAL_POOLS' if allready else 'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_ORIGINAL_BANKERS_LOAN_DEMAND_FIELD_METHOD_CLOCK_OR_FULL_SUPPORT',
 'source_gate_passed':bool(allready),'target_quarters':29,'original_pdf_current_values_found':sum(r['original_current_rate_percent'] is not None for r in rows),'original_current_methods_explicit':sum(r.get('original_method_current_object_explicit',False) for r in rows),'original_release_clocks_known':sum(r['original_publication_display']!='UNKNOWN' for r in rows),
 'known_later_version_quarters':later,'current_quarters_qualified':sum(r['source_gate_qualified'] for r in rows),
 'original_members':1711,'original_members_field_known':int(member['贷款总体需求指数'].notna().sum()),
 'original_score_dates':1212,'complete_current_and_original_mature_pools':ready,'deleted_original_members':0,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'information_state':'实际已公布调查原当前季度的陈旧信息快照，含原季度/公布钟/信息龄；未公布下一季不是可用最新季度，不把调查值日度化为真实需求。',
 'version_boundary':'发布页和实际原链接当前正文用于保守历史重构，首版/早于当前目录显示的真正第一次公开时刻仍未认证。已见晚版本必须未知，不用元数据当公布钟。',
 'new_equity_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authenticated_requests':0,
 'model_registration':'NOT_REGISTERED_SOURCE_STAGE_ONLY','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','full_goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'necessary_check':'全部29当前值/方法/原页钟、原件身份、全部1711/1212池完整和信息时钟逐行核对；未重复账户/模型。',
 'outputs':[ident(out/'全部29原问卷全文与目标当前值方法.json'),ident(out/'原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签.parquet'),ident(out/'全部1711原成员_需求信息与原公布钟.csv'),ident(out/'全部1212原评分日_需求全成熟池支持.csv')]
}
save('source_gate.json',gate)
save('result.json',{**gate,'actual_collection_ledger':readj(out/'实际取件调用账本.json'),'economic_increment':'NOT_TESTED_SOURCE_STAGE_ONLY'})
report=['# 银行家贷款总体需求：全原问卷与公布时间来源结论','',
 '固定2018Q3—2025Q3原29季度，原15旧用途文件实际全文核对未见同一评分用途。原目标及原1711/1212全保留。',
 '同一官方原目录实际5页找到全部29原发布页，29正文/29原附件一次取得。最初单页预算不足，金融使用前登记补充同一目录真实分页；初次目录回执序列化中断保留，续接已有5原页没有重新请求收到URL，4分页首次部分请求元信息未持久化明确未知。',
 '原当前目标值、当前方法和公布钟逐季保存。统计期不等于可用日期；2024Q3和Q4当前目录均2025-03-21、2025Q1和Q2均2025-07-25，不能把后来公布的主观调查值提前写入原季度。部分旧调查在季末前公布，访谈的真实起止日仍未知，不填成未来季末。',
 '原方法为本行本季贷款需求增长回答占比加基本不变占比的一半，银行受访者主观扩散指数。它不是贷款余额、增长率、审批条件、独立外生需求冲击、纯需求分量或股市资金流。银行母体/抽样/真实回答原说明另存。',
 '当前原页/链接正文及元日期未见已知晚版本矛盾时才作保守历史重构；首版和真正第一次历史可用时间未认证，不能据当前晚目录反推更早发布。来源通过仍不是策略成功或独立验证。',
 '',json.dumps(gate,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),
 '','[全部当前值与方法原全文](全部29原问卷全文与目标当前值方法.json)、[原完整母集](全部1711原成员_需求信息与原公布钟.csv)、[原全成熟池](全部1212原评分日_需求全成熟池支持.csv)、[来源门](source_gate.json)、[取件账本](实际取件调用账本.json)。']
(out/'银行贷款主观需求_原方法与公布滞后.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'状态':gate['status'],'全目标':29,'原值':gate['original_pdf_current_values_found'],'原方法':gate['original_current_methods_explicit'],'已知晚版本':later,'原1711已知':gate['original_members_field_known'],'全1212成熟池':ready,'金融拟合':0},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
